UserActivityProfile.title: UserActivityProfile
UserActivityProfile.description: Per-user activity dashboard document showing which user is active, total requests raised, Firebase vs Cloudflare breakdown, average solve latency, and cumulative active time in seconds. Clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp() for createdAt, updatedAt, and lastActiveAt.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID of the user.

displayName.description: User display name from Google Sign-In (0..120 characters).

email.description: User email address from Google Sign-In (0..254 characters).

appVersion.description: App version string such as '3.5.2' (1..32 characters).

totalRequests.description: Total solve requests raised by this user.

firebaseRequests.description: Requests answered via Firebase AI Logic.

cloudflareRequests.description: Requests answered via Cloudflare Workers AI.

cacheHits.description: Requests served instantly from local or shared cache.

failedRequests.description: Requests that ended in an error or timeout.

totalLatencyMs.description: Cumulative solve latency in milliseconds across completed requests.

avgLatencyMs.description: Running average solve latency in milliseconds.

totalActiveSeconds.description: Cumulative active app + Dynamic Island overlay time in seconds.

lastFeatureUsed.description: Most recent feature used by the user.

lastBackendUsed.description: Most recent backend that handled a request.

lastActiveAt.description: Most recent activity timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

createdAt.description: Immutable account telemetry creation timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Last modification timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

UserRequestLog.title: UserRequestLog
UserRequestLog.description: Immutable per-request audit entry showing which user raised a solve request, which feature and backend handled it, model name, latency, and result badge. Clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp() for createdAt.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID of the requesting user.

userEmail.description: Email of the requesting user for Firebase Console visibility (0..254 characters).

feature.description: App feature that initiated the solve request.

backend.description: Backend engine that fulfilled or failed the request.

modelUsed.description: Model identifier or provider label (0..120 characters).

questionPreview.description: Truncated preview of the question or form title (0..240 characters).

answerBadge.description: Short answer badge returned to the user (0..48 characters).

createdAt.description: Immutable server timestamp when the request completed.

UserActiveSession.title: UserActiveSession
UserActiveSession.description: Recorded foreground app or Dynamic Island active duration session for a user. Clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp() for endedAt.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID of the user.

userEmail.description: User email for Console visibility (0..254 characters).

source.description: Whether the active time was spent in the main app or floating Dynamic Island.

requestsCount.description: Number of requests raised during this active session.

deviceModel.description: Sanitized Android device model label (0..100 characters).

endedAt.description: Immutable server timestamp when the session slice was flushed.

SolvedQuestion.title: SolvedQuestion
SolvedQuestion.description: A solved quiz or study question with structured AI answer badge, concise explanation, subject tag, confidence score, and flashcard bookmark state. Clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp() for createdAt and updatedAt.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID of the question owner.

questionText.description: Extracted or typed question text (1..4000 characters).

answerBadge.description: Concise answer badge shown in the floating Dynamic Island (e.g. 'B', 'A, C', 'True', '42.5', '1-C, 2-A').

shortAnswer.description: Short answer phrase shown in Split Pill and Flashcards (0..300 characters).

explanation.description: Concise 2-line step-by-step explanation or formula breakdown (0..2000 characters).

subject.description: Subject domain used for solving and filtering.

language.description: Detected language of the source question (e.g. 'English', 'Hindi', 'Spanish').

translatedQuestion.description: Optional English translation when source question is in another language.

bookmarked.description: Whether the user starred this question for quick study review.

mistakeDeck.description: Whether this item is included in the active Liquid Glass Mistake Flashcard Deck.

createdAt.description: Immutable creation timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Last modification timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

SharedQuizCache.title: SharedQuizCache
SharedQuizCache.description: Immutable verified answer cache entry keyed by canonical 64-char SHA-256 hash of question + options. Clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp() for createdAt.

questionHash.description: 64-character lowercase hex SHA-256 signature of canonical normalized question text + options.

createdByUid.description: Authenticated Firebase UID of the contributor who first verified this answer.

answerBadge.description: Concise winning option badge (e.g. 'B', 'A, C', 'True', or short numeric answer).

shortAnswer.description: Exact wording of winning option or short value (0..300 characters).

explanation.description: Concise 1-sentence reason why the answer is correct (0..500 characters).

createdAt.description: Immutable creation timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

UserDailyUsage.title: UserDailyUsage
UserDailyUsage.description: Monotonic per-user UTC daily usage counters enforcing fair daily limits across Screen Solves, Ask AI Text, Photo Solves, PDF Solves, and Google Forms. Clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp() for createdAt and updatedAt.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID of the account owner.

dateKey.description: UTC date key in YYYY-MM-DD format.

overlayMcqCount.description: Cloud screen MCQ solves consumed today (0..1000).

askTextCount.description: Ask AI text prompts consumed today (0..1000).

askPhotoCount.description: Ask AI multimodal photo solves consumed today (0..1000).

askPdfCount.description: Ask AI PDF document solves consumed today (0..1000).

googleFormsCount.description: Google Forms batch solves consumed today (0..1000).

createdAt.description: Immutable creation timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Last increment timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

DeviceGuard.title: DeviceGuard
DeviceGuard.description: Hardware-bound anti-abuse and shared daily quota guard keyed by salted SHA-256 of ANDROID_ID. Prevents credit-hopping via Google account switching or account deletion/recreation, with monotonic strikeCount and irreversible ban enforcement.

deviceHash.description: 64-character lowercase hex SHA-256 hash of salted ANDROID_ID.

dateKey.description: Active UTC date key in YYYY-MM-DD format.

lastUid.description: Most recent authenticated Firebase UID active on this device.

seenUidCountToday.description: Number of distinct UIDs seen on this device today (1..100).

overlayMcqCount.description: Device-wide Screen Solve cloud uses today (0..1000).

askTextCount.description: Device-wide quick follow-up text uses today (0..1000).

askPhotoCount.description: Device-wide Photo Answer Key uses today (0..1000).

askPdfCount.description: Device-wide PDF Answer Key uses today (0..1000).

googleFormsCount.description: Device-wide Google Forms batch solves today (0..1000).

strikeCount.description: Monotonic fair-use abuse strike counter (0..10). Strike 1 = warning, Strike 2+ = device restriction.

banned.description: Irreversible device restriction flag once repeated credit-bypass abuse is detected.

lastStrikeReason.description: Human-readable reason for the latest fair-use warning or restriction (0..240 characters).

lastDeletedAccountAtMs.description: Epoch milliseconds of the last account deletion on this device after consuming credits.

createdAt.description: Immutable creation timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Last modification timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

SharedFormSolution.title: SharedFormSolution
SharedFormSolution.description: Shared jumble-proof Google Forms answer cache keyed by 64-char SHA-256 of canonical Form ID/URL. Stores canonical question stems and winning option text(s) so classmates with shuffled questions or shuffled option orders get instant answers without burning AI credits, while allowing single-question re-solve corrections to heal the cache via monotonic revision increments.

formHash.description: 64-character lowercase hex SHA-256 hash of canonical Google Form ID or URL.

createdByUid.description: Immutable Firebase UID of the first user who cached this form.

updatedByUid.description: Firebase UID of the most recent user who merged new pages or re-verified a question.

questionCount.description: Total number of cached questions stored in entriesJson (1..200).

revision.description: Monotonic cache revision counter incremented whenever a question is added or re-verified (1..10000).

entriesJson.description: Compact serialized JSON array of jumble-proof question stem + winning option text entries (2..90000 characters).

createdAt.description: Immutable server timestamp when this form was first cached.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest merge or single-question re-solve correction.

LiveClassRoom.title: LiveClassRoom
LiveClassRoom.description: Real-time Discord-style multiplayer study room keyed by a 6-character uppercase alphanumeric invite code. Strictly capped at 40 members with host-only approval, host-locked quiz URL, and 24-hour auto-expiry. Clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp() for createdAt and updatedAt.

roomName.description: Display title of the study room (1..80 characters).

subject.description: Subject bucket for the live study room.

hostUid.description: Immutable Firebase UID of the author/host who created the room.

hostName.description: Sanitized display name of the room creator (1..60 characters).

hostPhotoUrl.description: Optional public profile photo URL of the host (0..500 characters).

quizUrl.description: Host-locked exam or quiz URL (0..2048 characters). Only the room host can set or modify this URL.

maxMembers.description: Hard member capacity for this live room (strictly 40).

memberCount.description: Count of host-approved classmates currently in this room (1..40).

questionCount.description: Total synced questions currently inside this room (0..200).

active.description: True while the room is live; host can set false to close early.

expiresAtMs.description: Epoch milliseconds (24 hours after creation) when this room automatically expires.

createdAt.description: Immutable server timestamp when the room was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest host action or answer broadcast.

LiveRoomMember.title: LiveRoomMember
LiveRoomMember.description: Privacy-safe room membership record storing ONLY displayName, photoUrl, role, and host-controlled approval status (pending/approved/rejected). No email, phone, or profile inspection data is stored.

uid.description: Authenticated Firebase UID matching the document ID.

displayName.description: Public display name shown in the room member list (1..60 characters).

photoUrl.description: Public circular avatar URL shown in the room member list (0..500 characters).

status.description: Join approval state controlled exclusively by the room host.

joinedAt.description: Immutable server timestamp when join was requested.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of latest approval or display update.

LiveRoomAnswer.title: LiveRoomAnswer
LiveRoomAnswer.description: A live host-solved MCQ answer streamed simultaneously to all approved members in a LiveClassRoom. Stores exact shortAnswer text up to 600 chars for shuffled-option matching across classmates.

questionNumber.description: Sequential question number inside the room (1..200).

optionsJson.description: Serialized JSON array of option strings for jumble-safe matching (2..6000 characters).

shortAnswer.description: Exact wording of the correct answer for shuffled-option display and DOM locating (0..600 characters).

sourceLabel.description: Source badge such as 'Host Solved', 'Quiz Browser', or 'AI Verified' (1..60 characters).

sharedByUid.description: Immutable Firebase UID of the host who broadcast this answer.

sharedByName.description: Sanitized name of the host who shared this question (1..60 characters).

verifiedByAi.description: True when verified by the 1-tap AI tie-breaker.

updatedByUid.description: Firebase UID of the latest updater.

createdAt.description: Immutable server timestamp when first synced.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest update.

/users/{userId}.description: Per-user telemetry dashboard profile showing active time, request counts, average speed, and backend usage.

/users/{userId}/requestLogs/{requestId}.description: Immutable per-user log of every solve request raised across Dynamic Island, Google Forms, Photos, and PDFs.

/users/{userId}/activeSessions/{sessionI.description: Per-user active time sessions recorded from foreground app usage and floating Dynamic Island usage.

/users/{userId}/solvedQuestions/{questio.description: Per-user private collection of solved questions, explanations, bookmarks, and mistake flashcards.

/users/{userId}/dailyUsage/{dateKey}.description: Monotonic per-user daily feature usage counters (UTC day) preventing reinstall/clear-data quota bypass.

/deviceGuards/{deviceHash}.description: Hardware-bound shared daily quota & monotonic 2-strike anti-abuse guard preventing account switching or delete/recreate credit farming.

/sharedQuizCache/{questionHash}.description: Global verified question-hash answer cache enabling instant zero-AI-quota hits across users.

/sharedFormSolutions/{formHash}.description: Jumble-proof class-wide Google Form solution cache keyed by canonical form hash, enabling instant zero-AI solves and self-healing single-question re-solve updates.

/liveClassRooms/{roomCode}.description: Real-time Discord-style multiplayer class room (max 40 members, host-locked quiz URL, 24-hour auto-expiry).

/liveClassRooms/{roomCode}/members/{memb.description: Privacy-safe member list showing only displayName and photoUrl with host-only approval workflow.

/liveClassRooms/{roomCode}/answers/{answ.description: Real-time host-broadcast quiz answers inside a Live Class Room for shuffled-option-safe display.
